messages:

Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close window update — our internal hold on evaluation

Hannah —

Quick update from our side: internal legal and procurement just pushed the evaluation sign-off 2 weeks while they dig into data retention language and the audit schedule. That shifts our acceptance window out of the originally agreed week of 3/22 and into early April. We know this impacts your close plan.

Can you share a short remediation plan (MAP update) and any options to preserve the 3/22 cadence (e.g., limited-goals pilot, escrow of logs, temporary SLA)? Procurement also asked for a clean SOW redline they can route today.

Attaching the draft MAP we circulated last week for context.

Thanks —
Alex

Director, Platform Partnerships
Greenleaf Health

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Palmer <alex.palmer@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close window update — our internal hold on evaluation

Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and the MAP. I'm sorry to hear procurement needs extra time. We can do two things immediately to avoid derailing the overall timeline:

1) Run an "intervention sprint" this week focused on the procurement asks (SOW clean redline + targeted data-retention language).
2) Offer a scoped pilot that preserves the core acceptance criteria (latency + throughput) without full audit exposure — this would let you exercise the runtime for the primary KPIs while legal finishes the retention language.

I've attached an intervention checklist and an updated MAP (v3) that lays out owner-level actions, measurable gates, and a compressed go/no-go cadence. Markus will own the SOW redline; Marissa, can you prep an exec note for a potential one-time credit should the hold push us past 3/22?

Proposed next steps:
- Today: Markus to circulate SOW redline (target EOD PST) — Attachment: procurement_SOW_redlines.docx
- Tomorrow: Internal call (30m) triage with Greenleaf procurement/legal to confirm redline acceptance
- Monday: Pilot kick (if pilot accepted) with monitoring tags and a 7-day observation window

If we can get procurement to accept a limited pilot and the SOW redline, we can keep the commercial close on the week of 3/22. If not, MAP v3 shows the rebaseline path and communications cadence.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

I reviewed Greenleaf's retention questions and sketched a clean SOW redline focused on: limited retention for evaluation logs (30 days), explicit audit window commitments, and a clause for encrypted KV cache handling. I'm attaching the redline. It's intentionally narrow so procurement can route without infosec re-architecting.

If procurement needs longer retention during the pilot, we can add a controlled exception with a short approval path (security sign-off required).

I'll be available for the triage call tomorrow at 10am PT.

-Markus

Team —

Quick update from procurement: they reviewed Markus' redline and can accept the scoped retention language for a limited pilot. Legal still wants final language in DocuSign but procurement is comfortable moving the pilot forward. Procurement will sign the SOW once the DocuSign is in place.

We accept the pilot approach. Timeline:
- Fri 3/13: procurement to route and confirm on DocuSign
- Mon 3/16: pilot kickoff (limited acceptance tests: latency/throughput)
- Fri 3/20: pilot final check-in; provided pilot passes (metrics + no infra issues), Greenleaf will confirm commercial acceptance to preserve the 3/22 commercial close cadence.
